title: tdma_beacon: parse/serialize flag validation asymmetry
description: In rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs, parse() rejects reserved flags (bits 4-7) with ParseError::ReservedFlagSet (lines 64-66), but serialize() performs no validation. This allows creating a header with invalid flags, serializing it successfully, then failing to parse it back. Either: (1) trust-the-caller and remove parse validation, or (2) validate-everywhere and add serialize validation. Current state is inconsistent and could cause subtle roundtrip failures.
close_reason: Added reserved flag validation to serialize()
